name: night-shift-verify-flake
about: The night shift (docs/decisions/2026-10-20-night-shift.md). The control is auto; the approver's '@orchestrator night' turns it on until 08:00, answered by loopd without a turn. An item's verify fails twice and it goes to the user; the orchestrator escalates with class verify_flake. Its message says when the night shift acts; at 14 minutes nothing has happened; at its next minute's sweep after 15, loopd sends the item back to build with notes to re-run verify, posts 'Night shift: <action> — <reason>' with the undo in the thread, and the 09:00 standup lists it at the top. The rebuild's verify fails again; a second verify_flake on the same head stays with the user. '@orchestrator morning' turns it off.

messages.text: ^Night shift on until 08:00: I act on low-risk escalations after 15 minutes
